function.description: Read-only eth_call against any contract: the args are ABI-encoded from the signature (e.g. ownerOf(uint256) with [5]); give `returns` (e.g. 'address') to decode the result. Returns the raw hex too. No state change.
function.name: defi_data_contract_read

address.description: Contract address to read from (0x…). EVM chains only — there is no eth_call on solana.

args.description: Arguments, ABI-encoded from the signature, e.g. signature 'ownerOf(uint256)' with args [5]

chain.description: Chain to read from — the same address is a DIFFERENT token on a different chain, so name it deliberately. Readable: ethereum, base, robinhood, robinhood-testnet, arbitrum, polygon, optimism, bnb, solana.

returns.description: ABI types of the result, e.g. 'address' or '(uint256,address)'. Given: the result is decoded as these types. Omitted: raw hex plus a best-effort number
